title: The Healing Waters of Hot Springs
description: The history of Hot Springs, Arkansas, and the tension between folk belief in the healing waters and the medicine of the day.

title: Saint Cyprian on Works and Alms
description: Saint Cyprian of Carthage's treatise on almsgiving and good works, set beside the Anglican doctrine of justification by faith alone.

title: The Journey of John Henry Newman
description: How studying the Church Fathers led John Henry Newman from Anglican priest to Catholic cardinal.

title: The Hidden Centuries: The Ozarks Before Europeans
description: The Ozarks from the time of Jesus to the arrival of Europeans, from the bluff shelters to the Osage and de Soto.

title: The Unicorn of Moonlight Hollow
description: A short bedtime poem about a unicorn, made for Marie.

title: The Walking House, Episode 1: The Lantern Girl (Full Cast)
description: Dramatized with a full cast, music and sound effects. A lantern maker joins a wizard and his walking house. Made for Marie.

title: The People of the Buffalo
description: The Osage, Cherokee, Shawnee and Delaware along the Buffalo River from the 1700s to the early 1900s, and how they came to leave.

title: The Carpenter Who Found the Longitude
description: How John Harrison, a self taught country carpenter, built clocks of wood and brass that let sailors find their way at sea.
